hooks.text: You do not have to wait until 2061 to see Halley's Comet.
Tonight's shooting stars are actually burning pieces of Halley's Comet.
Earth smashes into Halley's Comet debris at 66 kilometers per second.

title: Halley's Comet Is Burning Above You TONIGHT
description: The Orionid meteor shower peaking tonight is made of dust and debris shed by Halley's Comet. Earth crosses the iconic comet's orbit twice every year.

beats.text: You do not have to wait until 2061 to see Halley's Comet.
beats.visual: telescopic photograph of Comet Halley displaying its tail, 1986

beats.text: Most people believe the iconic traveler vanished after 1986 and will not return for decades.
beats.visual: photograph of Comet Halley taken during its 1986 perihelion passage, 1986

beats.text: Halley takes about 76 years to orbit the Sun, shedding dust and debris along its path.
beats.visual: Giotto spacecraft image of the dark nucleus of Halley's Comet, 1986

beats.text: Every late October, Earth plows directly through this trail, igniting the Orionid meteor shower.
beats.visual: long-exposure photograph of Orionid meteors streaking across the night sky, 2020

beats.text: These particles strike the upper atmosphere at a blistering 66 kilometers per second.
beats.visual: photograph of a bright Orionid fireball burning in Earth's atmosphere, 2012

beats.text: That violent friction vaporizes the dust into incandescent trains lingering for seconds to minutes.
beats.visual: photograph of a persistent glowing meteor train lingering in the night sky, 2015

beats.text: Halley even produces a second shower, the Eta Aquariids, crossing Earth's path every May.
beats.visual: photograph of Eta Aquariid meteors streaking across the southern sky, 2013

beats.text: The famous traveler's ancient debris is already burning right above your head tonight.
beats.visual: wide-angle photograph of meteor streaks radiating from constellation Orion, 2018

better_than_last: Applies ep084 and ep114 learnings by eliminating redundant hook phrasing and using an abrupt punchline reveal that seamlessly loops back to beat 1.
